problems.stem: A car moves at constant speed around a circular track. What can we say about its acceleration?
problems.explanation: Constant speed means aₜ = 0. But direction changes, so aₙ = v²/r ≠ 0.

problems.stem: In which direction does the normal acceleration point?
problems.explanation: Normal (centripetal) acceleration always points toward the center of curvature.
